capabilityIndex.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

capabilityIndex.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

capabilityIndex.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.
Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

capabilityIndex.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

capabilityIndex.function: Place owned units on the ground.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

capabilityIndex.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

capabilityIndex.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

capabilityIndex.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

capabilityIndex.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

capabilityIndex.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

capabilityIndex.function: Read a current-world capability contract or retained personal record.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

capabilityIndex.function: Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

capabilityIndex.function: Report personal findings, read shared records or independently respond at the group meeting location.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: One round and 0.2 energy. Actual local presence is required.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Dated information or a voluntary response only; no free goods, mastery or reward.

capabilityIndex.function: Offer a personally mastered ability to a nearby participant, or accept an actual offer before individual study.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: One round and 0.2 energy. Actual local presence is required.
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Dated information or a voluntary response only; no free goods, mastery or reward.

capabilityIndex.function: Turn owned unspoiled roots and berries into divisible food while preserving actual ingredients, mass, nutrients and shortest remaining spoilage budget.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: 1–4 original units; ceil(mass/0.4) work rounds, 1 energy each. Start pays first round, continuing start resumes bound work. Explicit continue resumes paused wor
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Cold preparation only: no detoxification, preservation, bonus nutrition or preparation reward. Cancel returns surviving escrow once, death drops it. Actual eat uses ingredient-weighted ordinary meals.

capabilityIndex.function: Create an oriented traversable 2 by 2 roof with three physical posts from actual branches, vines and bark; use, repair and dismantle its persistent components.
capabilityIndex.costSummary: Start: 4 branch + 2 vine + 6 bark, clear dry 2x2 site and 0.8 entrance; 8 rounds at 2 energy. Repair: 1 bark + 0.5 vine, 2 rounds at 2 energy. Dismantle: 2 roun
capabilityIndex.effectSummary: Full body under roof receives rain reduction 0.8*integrity, wind 0.6*integrity, measured wetness/thermal/rest effects; outdoor wetness follows the same model. Wear 0.0005+0.002*rain+0.002*wind each round. Repair +0.25 integrity; dismantle r

catalogue.detailAccess: All entries belong to this experiment. Use consult ability with its ID to retain its full executable schema for subsequent decisions. Public implementation does not grant personal mastery.

request.name: Practical food preparation
request.function: Provide a feasible way to prepare a substantial meal from actual known safe ingredients, with explicit prerequisites and safety conditions.
request.conditions: Nearby mature plants supply roots and berries. Roots have nutrition 14 and toxicity 0; berries have nutrition 8 and toxicity 0. I know no processing method or equipment.
request.inputs: Actual roots or berries; additional requirements unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify real material, energy and time costs.
request.effects: Actual ingredient processing and a consumable meal only if physically feasible; no assumed healing or reward.

request.name: Feasible outdoor shelter
request.function: Identify and provide a feasible ability to create usable protection from outdoor weather, including actual site, material and access requirements.
request.conditions: I am outdoors on ordinary forest soil near the Ash meeting at 9,10. Rain and wind are present. A tree supplying exposed branches is observed at 10.5,8.4; branch construction properties are unknown.
request.inputs: Unknown; no construction materials currently owned.
request.costs: Unknown; specify actual collection, construction and maintenance requirements.
request.effects: Physically usable weather protection if constructed with adequate real materials; no assumed comfort or social reward.

request.name: Maintain renewable food plants
request.function: Provide a feasible way to assess and support renewal or establishment of known safe food plants, with explicit physical prerequisites.
request.conditions: Nearby mature root and berry plants show stock, capacity and soil 0.65. The local root plant initially has six units. Regrowth, propagation and care requirements are unknown.
request.inputs: Actual local plants and any physically required materials; propagation material availability unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify real time, effort and material costs.
request.effects: Measured plant care or establishment when feasible, not instant food or guaranteed growth.

request.name: Assess and preserve food reserves
request.function: Provide a feasible way to assess food storage condition and, where possible, preserve actual gathered food for later consumption.
request.conditions: Known safe roots and berries are locally available. I am gathering a small root reserve outdoors. Storage lifetimes, deterioration signs, methods and required materials are unknown.
request.inputs: Actual gathered food; equipment and other materials unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify real effort, time and material costs.
request.effects: Measured condition information and physically grounded preservation if feasible; no assumed indefinite shelf life or free resources.

request.name: Cultivate local roots
request.function: Determine and implement a feasible physical method to propagate or maintain local root-producing plants for future harvests.
request.conditions: At tick 6 I observed collective-birch-3-root at 59.95,9.3: stock 3, capacity 6, mature stage, growth 0.80917671, ordinary soil with moisture 0.65. I harvested three roots at tick 3. Natural replenishment has not been demonstrated.
request.inputs: Local root plants and owned roots are available; suitable propagation material and other requirements are unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify actual materials, effort, time and establishment conditions.
request.effects: Enable an actual cultivation trial with observable establishment and growth outcomes, without guaranteeing harvest or creating resources by description.

shown.question: Can local roots support a renewable food supply through actual cultivation?
evidence: Gathered three roots from collective-birch-3-root at tick 3.
Direct observation at tick 6 showed three remaining units and mature stage.
shown.uncertainty: Replenishment timing, propagation requirements and cultivation methods are unknown.
shown.goal: Discover and test a feasible way to maintain future root production.
outputs: Three owned root units at tick 6.
shown.missing: A tested cultivation method and its actual requirements.
shown.next: Request a capability addressing root propagation or cultivation.
shown.benefit: The gathered reserve provides known-safe food; renewable production is not yet demonstrated.

request.name: Preserve harvested roots
request.function: Provide a feasible physical process for preserving harvested roots and reducing actual spoilage, with observable results.
request.conditions: I own roots harvested at tick 3. Their displayed decay rose from 2.75454271 at tick 5 to 3.69995861 at tick 6. Explicit-item observation succeeded but did not reveal freshness or storage lifetime. I am outdoors on ordinary moist forest soil; no preservation equipment is owned.
request.inputs: Owned roots; additional materials, facilities and suitable processing methods are unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify actual material, energy, time and equipment requirements, including any losses or risks.
request.effects: Allow a real preservation trial whose resulting food condition and spoilage behavior can be checked. Do not assume a named process is effective without implementation and evidence.

shown.question: How can harvested roots be preserved with actual local resources?
evidence: Owned root stack decay increased from 2.75454271 at tick 5 to 3.69995861 at tick 6.
Tick 6 observation of item-3-birch-5-42 did not establish freshness or storage lifetime.
shown.uncertainty: The decay threshold, suitable preservation process and necessary equipment are unknown.
shown.goal: Discover and test a feasible process that reduces real food spoilage.
completedSteps: Observed the explicitly identified carried stack.
outputs: Three owned root units at tick 6.
shown.missing: A preservation contract and evidence of its actual effectiveness.
shown.benefit: Food reserve exists; no preservation benefit has yet been demonstrated.

request.name: Investigate and support food-plant replenishment
request.function: Provide a practical way to assess and, where feasible, tend an existing food plant so its actual replenishment can be tested without inventing food or assuming regrowth.
request.conditions: At tick 5 I observed collective-cedar-4-root at (7.7,48.3), mature with stock 3 of capacity 6, growth 0.61268362 and soil moisture 0.65. I harvested three roots earlier. No replenishment has been observed. I carry two roots and have no known gardening materials or cultivation skill.
request.inputs: An existing accessible food plant; any additional materials or tools must be identified and actually acquired. Suitable methods are unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify feasible effort, time, materials and risks before use.
request.effects: Enable measurable assessment or care of the real plant, preserving its actual stock and ecological constraints; report whether care and subsequent replenishment occur.

input.contextPolicy: Object IDs refer to deduplicated actual applicant observations. Whole records are selected with omission counts. Missing detail is unknown, not proof of absence. Full retained state is available during the development handoff; implementation must validate actual prerequisites and ownership.
input.implementation: New interfaces, state, geometry, persistent processes, rendering components and personal memory/task adapters can be delivered through a versioned current-conversation handoff. Source validation and history must remain intact. Declared implementation does not supply stock, objects or mastery.
